shortDescription: Weapon mounts that fire an ordinary ranged weapon item from a fixed position with more range. Manned mounts use the gunner's shooting skill, aim speed and traits, and give cover. With Biotech, automated mounts run on mech subcores or an AI persona core.
body:
# Mounted Weapons (v1 built, not yet tested in-game)

## What's in the mod
A mount is a turret (`MountedWeapons.Building_WeaponMount`, subclass of Building_TurretGun) that fires a real weapon item the player installs. Quality, art, HP, biocode state and comps stay with the item.

### Manned line (always loaded)
| Def | Research | Range | Stability | Aim time | Cover (fillPercent) | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MW_WeaponMount | MW_WeaponMounts (Smithing) | 115% | 0.20 | 100% | 0.40 | 40 wood/metal stuff |
| MW_WeaponMountReinforced | MW_ReinforcedMounts (+Machining) | 125% | 0.35 | 90% | 0.55 | 60 metal/stone stuff, 40 steel, 2 components |
| MW_GunEmplacement | MW_ArmoredEmplacements (+Microelectronics) | 135% | 0.50 | 80% | 0.75 | 100 steel, 50 plasteel, 4 components |

Stability = fraction of the gunner's per-cell miss chance the mount removes: perCell' = 1 - (1 - gunnerAcc) * (1 - stability). The gunner stands one cell behind (interaction cell), so the mount is their cover from the front.

### Automated line (Biotech folder, LoadFolders IfModActive Ludeon.RimWorld.Biotech)
| Def | Core | Research | ShootingAccuracyTurret (≈ skill) | Range | Aim | Power | Force-target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MW_AutoMountBasic | SubcoreBasic | MW_AutomatedMounts | 0.95 (~6) | 120% | 100% | 150 W | no |
| MW_AutoMountStandard | SubcoreRegular | + StandardMechtech | 0.97 (~10) | 125% | 90% | 200 W | no |
| MW_AutoMountHigh | SubcoreHigh | + HighMechtech | 0.98 (~14) | 130% | 80% | 250 W | yes |
| MW_AutoMountPersona | AIPersonaCore | + HighMechtech | 0.987 (~18) | 135% | 70% | 300 W | yes |
MW_AutomatedMounts needs MW_ReinforcedMounts + BasicMechtech. Without Biotech the whole branch is absent.

### Core refund
The core is in costList and in building.leavingsBlacklist (vanilla never refunds it). Building_WeaponMount.Destroy: Deconstruct (any non-kill, non-vanish mode) always drops the core; KillFinalize drops it on a 50% roll (MountExtension.coreLossChanceWhenKilled) with a message either way.

### Weapon lifecycle
- "Choose weapon" gizmo: float menu of mountable, unforbidden weapons on the map → sets pendingWeapon (saved by reference).
- WorkGiver MW_InstallMountedWeapon (Hauling, priority 135) → JobDriver carries it over, waits 180 ticks, InstallWeapon. Only the weapon is reserved, so a weapon can be swapped while a gunner mans the mount. An old weapon is dropped at the interaction cell.
- "Remove weapon" gizmo drops it (multi-select aware). Destroyed mount: weapon drops, losing 0–40% max HP when killed.
- Mountable = ranged primary, Verb_LaunchProjectile or Verb_ShootBeam subclass, not Verb_ShootOneUse, not in Grenades, not destroyOnDrop, not TurretGun-tagged, not biocoded. Pawn-equip restrictions from VE (HeavyWeapon) and DMS (HeavyEquippableExtension) don't apply to a building, so warcasket/DMS guns can be mounted.
- Empty mount holds placeholder MW_EmptyMountGun (Verb_MountEmpty, never Available). Base class assumes gun != null.

### Firing
- Range: each mounted verb gets a MemberwiseClone of its VerbProperties with range × rangeMultiplier (per-instance; reapplied at PostLoadInit; dropped on removal by replacing the VerbTracker).
- Warmup: def turretBurstWarmupTime 0; BeginBurst override runs a two-phase state machine (fireReadyTick) using weapon warmupTime × warmupFactor × gunner AimingDelayFactor (traits). OrderAttack clears a near-finished warmup when the target changes.
- Cooldown: weapon RangedWeapon_Cooldown stat (quality-aware) × cooldownFactor.
- XP: gunner gets vanilla Verb_Shoot XP (170/20 per cycle-second) when a burst actually starts.
- Draw: base texture rotates with the building; the weapon is drawn with PawnRenderUtility.DrawEquipmentAiming at Top.CurRotation; turret top material is cleared.

## Harmony patches
- Postfix `ShotReport.HitFactorFromShooter`: caster is a manned Building_WeaponMount → recompute with the gunner's ShootingAccuracyPawn plus stability (calls back with the pawn, so it can't loop).
- Prefix `Projectile.Launch` (8-arg overload): vanilla passes the building as equipment when manned; swap in the mounted weapon so quality damage and unique-weapon traits apply; traits re-applied on that path only.

## Known limits / ideas
- No firing arc (deferred by design).
- Mortars/flyOverhead launchers: IsMortar comes from the placeholder def, so mounts never use mortar targeting rules.
- A minified mount destroyed while packed loses its weapon (and core).
- Placeholder SVG art for all seven bases and two gizmo icons. weaponDrawOffset is 0 everywhere; tune after seeing it in-game.
- Combat Extended not supported.
